messages:
carla: Quick sync — token-cost attribution E2E check. We're aiming to have ownership + smoke tests nailed by EOW. Who's taking final ownership of the schema delta + PR reviews? cc @alice @ben

alice: I can own the event schema changes (embeddings->tokens mapping). Will open PR stub today, then iterate. ETA EOD.

ben: I'll take ingestion/pipe + latency hooks. Need a clear schema diff to implement transforms. @alice can you paste the delta here?

alice: Delta (short): `event.token_cost` -> `billing.tokens`, add `latency.ms` (int). PR WIP: github.com/redwood/instr/pull/3482 — tests + schema-lint next.

sam: Heads up — adding `latency.ms` to every event is small, but spike risk for kafka QPS during high concurrency. Batching will hide cost but worth canarying.

carla: Agreed. Ben — plan a canary that ships latency only for 10% traffic first?

ben: Yep. I'll add a feature-flag + rollout policy: 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 48h with automated revert on token-cost regression. Draft PR for rollout infra: github.com/redwood/ops/rollout/pull/67

dev-bot: CI passed on alice/instr-schema-3482 (unit + schema-lint). :white_check_mark:

alice: Thanks. @devex / docs folks — need a tiny console mapping blurb so cost UI shows `billing.tokens` as the attributed unit. @nina?

nina: I can draft the console mapping note and add an entry to the changelog. Draft will be in #docs by 16:00 PT.

carla: Any blockers or dangling CRs that will stop EOD?

ben: There's one CR blocking my changes: #3420 (kv-cache telemetry shape). @sam can you rebase that branch?

sam: On it — will rebase + fix tests in the next hour, then tag for review.

carla: Quick checklist before we close this thread: owners assigned (alice(schema), ben(ingest/rollout), nina(docs)), PRs tracked (#3482, #3420, #67), canary policy set, smoke tests (perf + token-cost regression), docs draft. If someone can't hit EOD, please reply here now.

alice: EOD is fine for me.

nina: EOD ok; doc draft by 4pm PT.

ben: Starting canary config now, target merge in ~6h. Will post config snippet here when ready.

sam: Tests green after rebase, pushed. tagging reviewers @ben @alice.

carla: Awesome, thanks everyone :thumbsup: I'll follow up tomorrow morning with the rollout playbook and rollback thresholds. If you find unexpected token-cost regressions during canary, raise an incident in #incidents and ping me.

ben: Posting config snippet now (will attach in follow-up):
```
feature_flag: telemetry_latency
canary: 10%
policy: 10->50->100 over 48h
monitoring: token_cost_daily, p50_latency
revert_on: token_cost > 5% uplift
```

carla: Perfect. Closing the async sync — will reopen if any blocker pops up.
